title: Chapter XV
chineseTitle: 第 15 章：足不出户的地理学家

paragraphs.en: The sixth planet was much larger than the previous ones and hosted an old gentleman who wrote extensive books.
paragraphs.zh: 第六颗行星比前几颗大得多，住着一位写了不少著作的老人。

paragraphs.en: "Look! An explorer!" he exclaimed upon seeing the little prince.
paragraphs.zh: “看！是一位探险家！”他一见到小王子便脱口而出。

paragraphs.en: The little prince sat down, panting from his long journey. "Where do you come from?" asked the old man.
paragraphs.zh: 小王子喘着气坐了下来。“你来自哪里？”老人问道。

paragraphs.en: "What's that big book?" the little prince inquired. "What are you doing?"
paragraphs.zh: “那本大书是什么？”小王子好奇地问道，“你这是在做什么？”

paragraphs.en: "I am a geographer," replied the old man.
paragraphs.zh: “我是一名地理学家，”老人回答道。

paragraphs.en: "What is a geographer?" the little prince wanted to know.
paragraphs.zh: “地理学家是做什么的？”小王子好奇地问道。

paragraphs.en: "A geographer knows all about seas, rivers, towns, mountains, and deserts."
paragraphs.zh: “地理学家对海洋、河流、城镇、山脉和沙漠了如指掌。”

paragraphs.en: "That sounds interesting," said the little prince. "Here's someone with a real job!"
paragraphs.zh: “这听起来挺有趣的，”小王子说道，“这里有个真正在做事的人！”

paragraphs.en: He looked around at the planet, finding it magnificent. "Your planet is beautiful," he remarked. "Does it have any oceans?"
paragraphs.zh: 他环视着这个星球，发现它壮丽非凡。“你们的星球真美，”他说，“这里有海洋吗？”

paragraphs.en: "I can't tell you," the geographer replied.
paragraphs.zh: “我不能告诉你，”地理学家回答道。

paragraphs.en: "Ah!" The little prince was disappointed. "What about mountains?"
paragraphs.zh: “啊！”小王子显得有些失望，“那山呢？”

paragraphs.en: Again, the geographer said, "I can't tell you."
paragraphs.zh: 地理学家又说：“这件事你没法知道。”

paragraphs.en: "And towns, rivers, and deserts?"
paragraphs.zh: “城镇、河流和沙漠？”

paragraphs.en: "Nope, I can't say anything about them either."
paragraphs.zh: “不行，我也没法对他们说什么。”

paragraphs.en: "But you are a geographer!"
paragraphs.zh: “你可是个地理学家！”

paragraphs.en: "Yes, but I'm not an explorer," the geographer explained. "I don't go out to discover these things. I stay at my desk, receiving explorers who tell me what they've seen.
paragraphs.zh: “是的，但我不是探险家，”地理学家解释道，“我不出去发现这些事情。我待在我的办公桌旁，接待那些向我讲述他们所见的探险家。”

paragraphs.en: If their stories seem interesting, I send someone to check."
paragraphs.zh: 如果他们的故事听起来有趣，我会派人去核实。

paragraphs.en: "Why do you need to check?" asked the little prince.
paragraphs.zh: “你为什么要查证呢？”小王子问道。

paragraphs.en: "Because a liar or an intoxicated explorer could ruin my records," explained the geographer.
paragraphs.zh: “因为一个说谎者或是醉酒的探险家都可能毁了我的记录，”地理学家解释道。

paragraphs.en: "I know someone who wouldn't make a good explorer," said the little prince.
paragraphs.zh: “我知道有人不适合当探险家。”小王子说道。

paragraphs.en: "That's possible," agreed the geographer. "So when their character is confirmed, we verify their findings."
paragraphs.zh: “这有可能，”地理学家赞同道，“所以当他们的性格得到确认时，我们就验证他们的发现。”

paragraphs.en: The geographer's excitement was sparked as he prepared to document the explorer’s journey.
paragraphs.zh: 地理学家的兴致被点燃了，他正准备记录探险家的旅程。

paragraphs.en: "Tell me about your world!" he urged. Opening his register and sharpening his pencil, he noted that explorers' accounts are initially recorded in pencil until verified with evidence.
paragraphs.zh: “给我讲讲你的世界！”他迫不及待地催促道，打开记事本，削尖了铅笔，记录下探险家的记载最初都是用铅笔写的，待证据核实后才会转为正式记录。

paragraphs.en: "What do you have on your planet?" asked the geographer eagerly.
paragraphs.zh: “你们星球上有什么？”地理学家迫不及待地问道。

paragraphs.en: The little prince replied, "It's not very exciting. I have three volcanoes—two active and one extinct. But who knows what might happen."
paragraphs.zh: 小王子回答说：“并没有什么特别激动人心的。我有三座火山——两座是活火山，一座是死火山。但谁知道会发生什么呢。”

paragraphs.en: "Unpredictable," echoed the geographer.
paragraphs.zh: “变幻莫测，”地理学家重复道。

paragraphs.en: "And a flower," added the little prince.
paragraphs.zh: “还有一朵花呢，”小王子补充道。

paragraphs.en: "But we don't record flowers," said the geographer dismissively.
paragraphs.zh: “但我们并不记录花朵。”地理学家轻蔑地说。

paragraphs.en: "Why not?" questioned the little prince, "It's the most beautiful thing on my planet!"
paragraphs.zh: “为什么不行呢？”小王子反问道，“这是我星球上最美丽的事物！”

paragraphs.en: "They are too fleeting for us to document," explained the geographer. "Geographies focus on eternal things like mountains and oceans."
paragraphs.zh: “它们太过瞬息万变，难以记录下来，”地理学家解释道，“地理学关注的是一些永恒的事物，比如山脉和海洋。”

paragraphs.en: "Even extinct volcanoes could erupt again," interrupted the little prince. "What does 'ephemeral' mean?"
paragraphs.zh: “就连熄灭的火山也可能再次喷发,”小王子插话说道。“‘瞬息即逝’是什么意思？”

paragraphs.en: "It means something that is likely to disappear quickly," replied the geographer.
paragraphs.zh: “这意味着一种很可能很快就会消失的东西。”地理学家回答道。

paragraphs.en: The little prince pondered, "Is my flower ephemeral?" he mused aloud. "And I left her alone on my planet!"
paragraphs.zh: 小王子沉思着自言自语：“我的花是不是会枯萎？”他不禁问道，“而且我还把她一个人留在了我的星球上！”

paragraphs.en: This was his first moment of regret. However, he regained his composure and asked, "What other planets should I visit?"
paragraphs.zh: 这是他第一次感到后悔。不过，他很快镇定了下来，问道：“还有哪些星球需要我访问？”

paragraphs.en: "The Earth has a good reputation," suggested the geographer.
paragraphs.zh: “地球一向颇有口碑。”地理学家建议说。

paragraphs.en: With renewed determination, the little prince departed, thinking about his flower.
paragraphs.zh: 带着重振旗鼓的决心，小王子离开了，心中想着他的花儿。
